rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The announcer introduces "President of the Russian Federation Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin", who speaks before the oath and says that "now, laying down the powers of head of state" he regards the duty to preserve Russia as his highest civic duty, and that he is handing Medvedev the symbol of state power that day.
rows.locator: Transcript: announcer's introduction and Putin's address, before Zorkin's invitation to take the oath

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Citing Article 82(1) of the Constitution, Zorkin invites Dmitry Anatolyevich Medvedev to take the oath, and Medvedev recites the presidential oath.
rows.locator: Transcript: Zorkin's invitation and Medvedev's oath

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Immediately after the oath Zorkin declares: "Dmitry Anatolyevich Medvedev has taken office as President of Russia"; the anthem is played and the announcer introduces "President of the Russian Federation Dmitry Anatolyevich Medvedev", who says he has just taken the presidential oath.
rows.locator: Transcript: Zorkin's declaration after the oath; announcer; opening of Medvedev's address
